array.string: /sbin/ifconfig lo0 alias $LOOPBACK_IP up rebind() { [ -f "\$1" ] || return 0 /bin/launchctl bootout "system/\$2" 2>/dev/null || /bin/launchctl unload "\$1" 2>/dev/null /bin/launchctl bootstrap system "\$1" 2>/dev/null || /bin/launchctl load "\$1" 2>/dev/null } rebind $LAUNCHD_DIR/$TUNNEL_LABEL.plist $TUNNEL_LABEL rebind $LAUNCHD_DIR/$ADMIN_LABEL.plist $ADMIN_LABEL
